plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps both Parties at one month of Fees paid 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims regime in 21.3 and is far below a meaningful cap — likely deviation. Read 21.2-21.4 together before flagging.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-gives indemnity (20.1); no Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity appears, and Sec 9.3 cross-references a Section 20.5 that does not exist. Treat as missing Vendor indemnity plus overbroad Customer indemnity.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month, worldwide, all-product non-compete on Customer — direct breach. Note the conflict with Sec 12.3, which disclaims any such commitment.
Sec 2.2 (first of two 2.2s) makes Vendor sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics — deviation; Sec 12.3 disclaims exclusivity, so cite the inconsistency.
No MFN obligation on Customer located; Sec 12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment. Confirm no pricing MFN hides in Sec 7 or 8.
No non-solicit binding Customer found; Sec 12.3 confirms no no-hire commitment and preserves general recruitment hiring.

Sec 9.4 gives Customer 30-day convenience termination with refunds and denies Vendor the same — favourable. But check Sec 2.1's no-termination take-or-pay, which undercuts it (flag under MINCOMMIT, not twice here).
Sec 8.2 gives a 30-day opt-out plus a 60-day reminder with deadline extension; Sec 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3%. Likely compliant.
New York law and exclusive New York County courts, with an executive escalation step — within accepted list; likely compliant.
Sec 24.1 permits Customer affiliate/successor assignment without consent; 24.2 restricts Vendor; 24.4 bars Vendor exit on Customer change of control. Likely compliant.

Customer owns Customer Data (14.1) and Deliverables assigned on creation subject to payment (14.2); Vendor retains only Vendor Technology with a perpetual licence back. Check 15.1 no-model-training limit; likely compliant.

Sec 13.1 grants a Customer-only licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, excluding Affiliates and contractors — material deviation notwithstanding the broader paid-up grant in 13.2 and the revocation limit in 13.3.
Sec 22.1-22.3 give once-yearly, 30-day notice, off-site-where-practicable audits at Vendor's cost subject to a 5% shortfall shift. Likely compliant.
No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer identified; Sec 7.3 bars interest on amounts not due and 9.4 is penalty-free. The take-or-pay in Sec 2.1 is addressed under MINCOMMIT.

Sec 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformity warranty to 15 days with no obligation afterwards — likely too short against the fallback; weigh against 19.1, 19.4 remedies and the Section 6 acceptance cycle.
Sec 18.1 sets CGL, workers' comp, E&O and USD 5m cyber cover for the term plus one year; 18.2 adds certificates and non-limitation. Likely compliant.
Sec 2.1 imposes USD 2m/year take-or-pay for three years expressly without reduction or termination rights — clear deviation; cite tension with Sec 9.4 and 12.3.
Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion with no export — deviation; contrast Sec 11.2/11.3 data-return and certified-deletion mechanics and resolve the internal conflict.
